bug_summary: PVC_INCLUDE_PLACEHOLDERS定数が0x0020(実際は0x0010=PVC_RECURSE_PLACEHOLDERSと衝突)になっており、PlaceHolderVarの事前登録が漏れてパーティション結合クエリが実行時エラーになっていた
pr_description: Renumber the local `PVC_INCLUDE_PLACEHOLDERS` constant in `placeholder.rs` to `0x0020` to keep the `pull_var_clause` flag bits in this crate aligned with the numbering convention used elsewhere in the optimizer flag set.
